name: Temporary Residence as Student

requirements.blocker_text: Requires an electronic enrollment certificate; interns and scholarship recipients additionally need an international agreement or acceptance letter.
requirements.fix_path: Secure enrollment at a recognized Argentine institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires an Argentine criminal background certificate and foreign criminal records from any country resided in for 1+ years during the past 3 years (applicants 16+).

evidence_required.document: For minors: legalized birth certificate and notarized parental authorization

sources.title: Dirección Nacional de Migraciones -- Obtener una residencia temporaria como estudiante: full-time students, interns, and scholarship recipients; 1-year renewable; RaDEX process

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Argentina). No work rights are granted on this category per the source; consistent with several other countries in this dataset that bar student-visa work entirely rather than allowing restricted part-time hours.
